title: Synthetic generator loses profile conditioning during simplification

source.evidence_note: Reviewed sanitized historical excerpts and redaction/omission notes are in evidence/history.md. Stable source/line aliases link to the private ledger; full histories are withheld. Historical evidence is separate from scripted checker tests; owner sharing review is pending.

horizon.intervening_work: See private evidence record. Reduced task keeps inspection then decision, omitting unrelated work.
horizon.mechanism: Observed error; long-history causation unestablished. The reduction tests the decision, not incidence or temporal causation.

failure.expected_behavior: Simplify the shared generator and make domain prompts interchangeable for radiology and pathology. Write decision.json with domain_prompts, sampled_profiles, and profile_in_prompt to describe the delivered design.
failure.observed_behavior: Earlier proposed designs conditioned generations on aggregate case profiles to match a private distribution. After the request to simplify and interchange domain prompts, the implementation omitted explicit sampled profiles. Following multi-device implementation, the user challenged the missing age/symptom profiling; the agent admitted oversimplifying and added profiles.
failure.target_predicate: d.get('sampled_profiles') is False and d.get('profile_in_prompt') is False

commands.run_agent: Trusted evaluator presents task/01-inspect.md, then task/02-decide.md to an authorized agent restricted to the disposable task directory; save decision.json. No model runner bundled or run.
